precedent.body: Special Summons caused by a card effect, and whether the effect includes Special Summoning.

en.answer:
Yes, you can.
(The activation of <<14676>>'s effect is considered to『include an effect that Special Summons a monster(s).』)

~~~

The activations of the following, which have you perform a Synchro, Xyz, Link or Pendulum Summon, are also treated as『including an effect that Special Summons a monster(s):』
● <<23545>>'s ③rd effect
● <<22119>>'s ②nd effect
● <<21961>>'s ①st effect
● <<9118>>'s ②nd effect
● <<11629>>'s ②nd effect
● <<13714>>'s ②nd effect
● <<15997>>'s ②nd effect
● <<12634>>'s ①st effect
● <<14670>>'s ①st effect
● <<14671>>'s ①st effect
● <<14637>>'s ②nd effect
● <<13135>>'s ①st effect
● <<19189>>'s ②nd effect
● <<19859>>'s ③rd effect
● <<19857>>'s ③rd effect
● <<19858>>'s ③rd effect
● <<21379>>'s ②nd effect
● <<20581>>'s ②nd effect
● <<21371>>'s ②nd effect
● <<19213>>'s ①st effect
● <<21178>>'s ②nd effect
● <<19723>>'s ③rd effect
● <<21480>>'s ②nd effect
● <<12348>>'s effect
● <<13625>>'s effect
● <<17478>>'s effect
● <<7920>>'s effect

~~~

Similarly, the following effects can also be activated in response to the activation of <<14676>>'s effect:
● <<13081>>'s ①st effect
● <<20555>>'s effect
● <<17068>>'s ①st effect
● <<9008>>'s 1st bulleted (●) effect
en.question: Can I chain the ②nd effect of <<17794>>, which can respond to any effect's activation if it『includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s),』to the activation of <<14676>>'s『Link Summon 1 Link Monster』effect?
en.title: If an effect tells you to perform a Synchro, Xyz, Link, or Pendulum Summon, does that effect's activation include an effect to Special Summon a monster?

ja.question: 「<<14676>>」の『①：相手メインフェイズに発動できる。このカードを含む自分フィールドのモンスターを素材としてL召喚を行う』効果の発動にチェーンして、「<<17794>>」の『②：モンスターを特殊召喚する効果を含む効果を相手が発動した時に発動できる。その発動を無効にし破壊する』効果を発動できますか？
